question: Mr. I starts from Point J and drives 5 km towards the west. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. He then takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point K. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point J again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:** **

Mr. I starts from Point J and drives 5 km towards the west.

He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 11 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 2 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km.

He then takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point K. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29ab5fef81e4b76fd60981534427b4f492d0584a0daa4f3f03d28c40ee6ebcfe.png] 

Thus, Mr. I should drive 10 km in the west direction in order to reach Point J again.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
